title: Past Forever
prompt:
[Intro: piano and strings, a lone guitar note sustaining]

[Verse 1: raspy male tenor, low at first]
I said "for better and for worse" in a rented suit
I didn't know a thing about the worse
I thought forever was a word you said
Like "amen," at the end of every verse

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
Then came the layoff, and your mother, and the scare
And you, in the waiting room, not going anywhere

[Chorus: full band, voice at the top of its range]
So I'll love you past forever
Past the stars and past the dark
Past the day they take my name down off the mailbox by the park
I didn't know what I was saying then
I know it now, so ask me again
I'll love you past forever

[Verse 2: voice stronger, guitars chiming]
You've seen me broke, you've seen me mean, you've seen me cry
You've seen me lose my hair and lose my nerve
I've seen you carry more than any two should
And never once behave as you deserved

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
This ring's too tight, it's been too tight for years
I've never had it off. I'm not starting here.

[Chorus: full band, voice at the top of its range]
So I'll love you past forever
Past the stars and past the dark
Past the day they take my name down off the mailbox by the park
I didn't know what I was saying then
I know it now, so ask me again
I'll love you past forever

[Guitar Solo: soaring, melodic, over the chorus]

[Bridge: band drops to piano, voice close]
If you go first, I'll talk to you at breakfast
If I go first, check the porch at dusk

[Final Chorus: key up, everything at full stretch]
I'll love you past forever
Past the stars and past the dark
Past the day they take my name down off the mailbox by the park
I didn't know what I was saying then
I know it now, so ask me again
I'll love you past forever

[Outro: piano, "Do you?" "I do. Still."]
